# This FC analysis is EXPLORATORY

## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(afex) # v.1.4-1
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1 
library(tidyr) # v.1.3.1
library(emmeans) # v.2.0.4

df_FC_rest <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "averageFC_rest.csv"), sep=",")

df_FC_res <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "averageFC_res.csv"), sep=",")

df_FC_rawfunc <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "averageFC_rawfunc.csv"), sep=",")


```

## prepare data

```{r}
df <- df_FC_rawfunc %>%
  left_join(df_FC_res %>%
      select(sub_name, overall_FC_res = overall_FC, overall_FC_abs_res = overall_FC_abs), by = "sub_name")

df_rest <- df %>%
  left_join(df_FC_rest %>%
      select(sub_name, overall_FC_rest = overall_FC, overall_FC_abs_rest = overall_FC_abs), by = "sub_name")

colnames(df) <- c("Subject", "overallFC_rawfunc", "absFC_rawfunc", "overallFC_res", "absFC_res")
colnames(df_rest) <- c("Subject", "overallFC_rawfunc", "absFC_rawfunc", "overallFC_res", "absFC_res",
                   "overallFC_rest", "absFC_rest")

data_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Subject,
    names_to = c("Measure", "FC_type"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "FC"
  )

data_long_rest <- df_rest %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Subject,
    names_to = c("Measure", "FC_type"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "FC"
  )
```

## ANOVA

```{r}
anova_model <- aov_ez(
  id = "Subject",
  dv = "FC",
  data = data_long,
  within = c("Measure", "FC_type")
)

anova_model

emmeans(anova_model, pairwise ~ FC_type | Measure)
```
